# row echelon form　`def.row-echelon-form`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=def.row-echelon-form)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./def.row-echelon-form.md)

Uses: solving linear systems (pivot columns correspond to basic variables, the other columns to free variables), computing rank (count the pivots), inverting (reduce $[A \mid I]$), and finding a basis of the column space (the pivot columns).

Elementary row operations correspond to left multiplication by elementary matrices; RREF is the "normal form under row operations", while equivalence also allows column operations, with normal form $\operatorname{diag}(I_r, 0)$.

> Proofs of the edges are still Chinese only: `proofs/`; the Chinese page remains authoritative.
